horoscope: Don't force yourself to hide your feelings or rush into taking a relationship to the next level today. The Moon's transit through your sign may give you more energy and make it easier to express yourself. You might feel a little jealous if a close friend spends time with someone else, but don't let unnecessary doubts take over. Be patient and trust that good times are ahead.
love: With Venus’s influence, your relationship might take one step further today. Try to find out with your partner what you want from this relationship. Our expert astrologer advises that you don’t hesitate to express your feelings or opinions clearly.
finance: Today, communication and contacts will benefit you in financial matters. With mercury’s influence, some business deals or contracts may take further steps today. Job holders could get another source of income. However, don’t invest due to others' influence and be careful about savings. Astrotalk’s astrologer advises that written documents are a must in financial deals.
career: Don't hesitate to ask your colleagues for help at work today. Venus may bring a chance to learn something useful from their experience and improve the way you do your job. This could also give you more confidence. Our astrologers advise working together as a team and staying open to new ideas.
health: Today you might feel attracted to spiritual things. Gathering information related to yoga, meditation, and breathing practices is also important; before adopting any habits, you should know them all. Venus transitions may encourage you to pursue self-realisation. Our Astrotalk astrologers advise you to take health-related decisions wisely.
